fusions.name: Razor Tresses
fusions.desc: Whips two fine strands across the target, dealing 3 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 10% slower for 1 second.

fusions.name: Braid Snap
fusions.desc: Cracks a braid at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Woven Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Static Bristle
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
